changelog.body:
### Changed

- Migrated from the legacy Xposed API (82) to libxposed API (101).

### Fixed

- Declare the framework scope as `system` so LSPosed recommends System Framework for the module.

### Added

- Android 16 QPR1 support.

### Fixed

- Hardened all hooks against methods removed or renamed on newer ROMs.

### Added

- Added "Fixed IP/port" toggle on the Wireless Debugging screen to listen on `192.168.49.1:5555`.

### Fixed

- Various UI sync and lifecycle issues on Settings screens.

### Fixed

- Fixed wrong IP shown on Wireless Debugging screen when hotspot is active.
- Fixed button label not updating on hotspot/Wi-Fi state changes.

readme:
# Hotspot Wireless Debugging Xposed module that makes Wireless Debugging (ADB over Wi-Fi) work over Wi-Fi Hotspot on Android 15/16. Android 11+ only enables Wireless Debugging when the device is connected to Wi-Fi as a client. This module removes that restriction so hotspot guests can connect via ADB. ## Requirements - Android 15 to 16 QPR1 - Magisk or other Zygisk implementation - LSPosed/Vector ### Tested configurations | Device | Android | ROM | Zygisk | Xposed | | --- | --- | --- | --- | -- | | enchilada | 15 | LineageOS 22.2 | Magisk 30.7
NeoZygisk 2.3 | LSPosed 1.9.2
Vector 2.0 | | tucana | 16 | LineageOS 23.2 | Magisk 30.7 | Vector 2.0 | | enchilada | 16 QPR1 | crDroid 12.5 | Magisk 30.7 | LSPosed 2.1.0 | If this module works (or not) on your device/ROM, please [open an issue](https://github.com/droserasprout/io.drsr.hotspotadb/issues). ## Installation Grab the APK from Xposed Module Repo, [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/droserasprout/io.drsr.hotspotadb/releases), or [build from source](#building-from-source). 1. Install the APK 2. Enable the module in LSPosed for two scopes: - `com.android.settings` - `system` (System Framework) 3. Reboot ## Usage 1. Enable Wi-Fi Hotspot 2. Use the Wireless Debugging toggle on the hotspot settings screen, or go to Developer Options > Wireless Debugging 3. On the first connection, pair your client device: `adb pair : ` 4. Connect: `adb connect :` ### Fixed IP/port (optional) Flip **Fixed IP/port** to always listen on `192.168.49.1:5555`. Lets you script the command without needing mDNS in your `adb` build. Pairing still uses the ephemeral port shown on screen (one-time step). How it works: - `192.168.49.1/24` is aliased on the hotspot interface via netd (secondary address) - A TCP proxy in `system_server` listens on `:5555` and forwards to adbd's ephemeral TLS port (TLS is end-to-end, proxy is just a byte pipe) Trade-off: if your upstream network also uses `192.168.49.0/24`, leave this feature off to avoid routing collisions. ## Building from source Requires JDK 21 and Android SDK. ```shell make build # debug APK make install # install via Gradle make clean ``` ## Other solutions [Magisk-WiFiADB](https://github.com/mrh929/magisk-wifiadb) — enables legacy `adb tcpip` on boot. Simpler (Magisk only, any Android), but unencrypted and not hotspot-aware. ## License [GPL-3.0](https://github.com/droserasprout/io.drsr.hotspotadb/blob/main/LICENSE)

# 热点无线调试 Xpose 模块使无线调试（ADB over Wi-Fi）在 Android 15/16 上通过 Wi-Fi 热点工作。 Android 11+ 仅当设备作为客户端连接到 Wi-Fi 时才启用无线调试。该模块消除了该限制，以便热点访客可以通过 ADB 连接。 ## 要求 - Android 15 至 16 QPR1 - Magisk 或其他 Zygisk 实施 - LS 姿势/矢量 ### 测试配置 |设备|安卓 | ROM |齐吉斯克 | Xpose| | --- | --- | --- | --- | --| |辣酱玉米饼馅| 15 | 15 LineageOS 22.2 | Magisk 30.7
NeoZygisk 2.3 | Magisk 30.7
LSPod 1.9.2 向量2.0 | |杜卡纳 | 16 | 16 LineageOS 23.2 |玛吉斯克 30.7 |矢量2.0 | |辣酱玉米饼馅| 16 QPR1 | crDroid 12.5 |玛吉斯克 30.7 | LSPod 2.1.0 | 如果此模块在您的设备/ROM 上运行（或无法运行），请[提出问题](https://github.com/droserasprout/io.drsr.hotspotadb/issues)。 ## 安装 从 Xposed 模块存储库、[GitHub 版本](https://github.com/droserasprout/io.drsr.hotspotadb/releases) 或 [从源代码构建](#building-from-source) 获取 APK。 1.安装APK 2. 在 LSPoded 中为两个范围启用该模块： - `com.android.settings` - `系统`（系统框架） 3. 重新启动 ## 用法 1.启用Wi-Fi热点 2. 使用热点设置屏幕上的“无线调试”开关，或转到“开发人员选项”>“无线调试” 3. 在第一次连接时，配对您的客户端设备：`adbpair : ` 4. 连接：`adb connect :<端口>` ### 固定IP/端口（可选） 翻转 **固定 IP/端口** 以始终侦听“192.168.49.1:5555”。允许您编写命令脚本，而无需在“adb”构建中使用 mDNS。配对仍使用屏幕上显示的临时端口（一次性步骤）。 工作原理： - `192.168.49.1/24` 通过 netd 在热点接口上使用别名（辅助地址） - `system_server` 中的 TCP 代理监听 `:5555` 并转发到 adbd 的临时 TLS 端口（TLS 是端到端的，代理只是一个字节管道） 权衡：如果您的上游网络也使用“192.168.49.0/24”，请关闭此功能以避免路由冲突。 ## 从源代码构建 需要 JDK 21 和 Android SDK。 ````外壳 make build # 调试APK make install # 通过 Gradle 安装 使干净 ```` ## 其他解决方案 [Magisk-WiFiADB](https://github.com/mrh929/magisk-wifiadb) — 在启动时启用旧版 `adb tcpip`。更简单（仅限 Magisk，任何 Android），但未加密且不支持热点。 ## 许可证 [GPL-3.0](https://github.com/droserasprout/io.drsr.hotspotadb/blob/main/LICENSE)
